Context: 6. Permanent transfer to and from Central Autonomous/Statutory Bodies Counting of past service for pension

Central Government employee with CPF benefits, the amount of his subscriptions and the Government's contribution together with interest thereon will be transferred to his new Provident Fund account with the consent of that Body.
